items.title: Sasha wanted to trace her genealogy. Instead she uncovered a life-changing mistake
items.description: When Sasha Szafranski matched with a stranger on a genealogy website, she uncovered an IVF mix-up that had been hidden for 30 years.

items.title: Live: Architect of Coalition's WFH policy endorses Nationals' regional plan
items.description: Deputy Liberal Leader Jane Hume endorses the National Party's policy to encourage working from home for regional and rural-based public servants. Follow live.

items.title: 'We have exciting days ahead': Danish royals arrive in Melbourne
items.description: The king and queen of Denmark will arrive in Melbourne for the first of two days of royal engagements as part of their Australian state visit.

items.title: What are the chances the RBA will raise interest rates today?
items.description: The market thinks the RBA is likely to lift interest rates today, with increasing uncertainty surrounding inflation as the Middle East war puts upward pressure on prices.

items.title: $30K drone reshapes how Australia and the world view future wars
items.description: Defence analysts say the early lessons of the Iran conflict are fairly clear: drone warfare is here to stay and Australia needs to rapidly improve its counter-drone capabilities.

items.title: Live: Trump scolds allies for failing to help secure Strait of Hormuz, says 'level of enthusiasm' matters
items.description: The US president hits out at European allies, who he says "weren't that enthusiastic" about helping, as Iranian drones and missiles closed the shipping channel. Follow live.

items.title: This is the shocking state of a rich Venezuelan oil town that went bust
items.description: Foreign Correspondent goes inside Venezuela's oil regions, where boom towns have gone bust, leaving behind a shattered industry that needs billions to reboot.

items.title: Live: Australian share market on the rise as RBA rate hike looms
items.description: The Reserve Bank is almost universally tipped to raise interest rates again this afternoon. The ASX is higher after a rally on Wall Street. Follow the latest updates in our live blog.

items.title: The rate hike that will do nothing to curb inflation
items.description: As Reserve Bank board members gather for the second day of meetings this morning, they already would have been peppered with dire warnings about the potential impact of the energy shock.

items.title: Experts unsure how 'world's most destructive bee pests' landed in Australia
items.description: Australia's leading biosecurity experts have been unable to trace the source of the of the bee-killing varroa mite incursion which has changed the face of beekeeping and pollination in Australia.

items.title: Adrift Russian tanker poses serious risk of 'major ecological disaster'
items.description: Italy, France and seven other nations say a Russian liquefied natural gas tanker adrift in the Mediterranean represents an ecological threat, urging swift action.

items.title: Towns pick up the pieces after loss of Commonwealth Games that should have started today
items.description: The 2026 Victorian Commonwealth Games would have started today, but attention now turns to the unbuilt housing and unfinished regional projects that were promised.

items.title: Focus on men's health may improve pregnancy outcomes, experts say
items.description: Experts say putting the spotlight on sperm — and men's pre-conception health more broadly — will improve pregnancy outcomes. Here's why.

items.title: Woman alleges rape by men she thought were Uber drivers
items.description: Two men are on trial in the Northern Territory Supreme Court, accused of sexually assaulting a young woman in her apartment for eight hours after picking her up on a night out while she was waiting for an Uber.

items.title: Thousands using 'loophole' to own firearms, report claims
items.description: Hundreds of thousands of gun owners are using a "loophole" in Australia's firearms laws to own guns without a genuine reason, according to a report by the Australia Institute.

items.title: Timothée Chalamet's Oscars campaign was DOA before he dissed ballet
items.description: At the beginning of 2025, Timothée Chalamet was the hot pick for the Best Actor Oscar for his turn in Marty Supreme. But a lot can change in a few months.

items.title: Why — and how — I'm taking a break from my husband
items.description: After almost five decades of marriage, I needed a break. And since enjoying my new-found freedom, I'm not sure I'll ever go back.

items.title: ABC Places quiz: Where in the world are we?
items.description: Today's ABC Places quiz features photos from 10 locations around the world. Your challenge is to guess where you are.

items.title: New laws for NSW after 'sickening' attacks on LGBTQIA+ teens
items.description: Offenders convicted of hate crimes against the LGBTQIA+ community in New South Wales could face up to seven years behind bars under new legislation being introduced to parliament.

items.title: Victorian teachers reject pay offer as statewide strike looms
items.description: The state government has made its first pay offer to teachers in an attempt to avoid next week's 24 hour statewide strike.

items.title: How to watch Matildas vs China in Women's Asian Cup semifinal
items.description: The Matildas are in the final four at the Women's Asian Cup, and take on the defending champion China in the first semifinal tonight. Here's how to follow the game at Perth Stadium.

items.title: Duck hunters blame protesters after mysterious shelter fires
items.description: Tasmanian duck hunters believe their shooting shelters, known as hides, are being burnt down by protesters, with 80 destroyed in the past four years.

items.title: Irish culture is now 'sexy' — and it's not just Cillian Murphy's fault
items.description: This St Patrick's Day, green beer and leprechauns are out as a new Irish identity rejects caricature in favour of authentic culture and language.

items.title: Chelsea receives record Premier League fine for breaches of financial rules
items.description: Chelsea are fined a record total of $20.2 million for historical breaches of the Premier League's financial regulations, but avoid a points deduction.

items.title: Australian tennis coach cops doping ban after admitting to blood transfusion
items.description: Former world number 39 Marinko Matosevic receives a four-year doping ban from tennis's global integrity agency, which he had labelled "corrupt" during its investigation.
